title: Invert Binary Tree
prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, invert the tree, and return its root.
hints: Recursive: swap left and right children of the current node, then recursively invert left and right subtrees.
Base case: if root is null, return null.
Post-order or pre-order both work. Swap before or after the recursive calls.
O(n) time, O(h) space for recursion stack.
